title: CRUD utils in R for Supabase
code: library(supabaseR) > supabaseR v... >   DBI Backend: ✔ >   API Backend: ✖  sb_db_connect() > ✔ Connected to db.xxx.supabase.co  # Read sb_db_tables() sb_db_schema("users") sb_db_read("users", limit = 10)  # Query with operators sb_db_query("users", where = list(id = 1)) sb_db_query("users", where = list(age = list(gt = 18))) sb_db_query("users", where = list(name = list(like = "A%"))) sb_db_query("users", where = list(id = list("in" = c(1, 2, 3))))  # Raw SQL sb_db_query(sql = "SELECT * FROM public.users WHERE id = 1")  # Write sb_db_insert("users", data.frame(name = "Alice")) > ✔ Inserted 1 row into users  sb_db_update("users", data = list(name = "Bob"), where = list(id = 1)) > ✔ Updated 1 row in users  sb_db_upsert("users", data.frame(id = 1, name = "Charlie"), conflict_columns = "id") > ✔ Upserted 1 row into users  sb_db_delete("users", where = list(id = 1)) > ✔ Deleted 1 row from users  sb_db_disconnect() > ✔ Disconnected
